SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema IN ('store','warehouse','payments')
  AND (table_schema, table_name) IN (
    ('store','goods_receipts'),('store','inventory_book'),('store','pos_lines'),
    ('store','products'),('store','shelf_audits'),('store','stock_counts'),
    ('store','store_orders'),('store','store_order_lines'),('store','write_offs'),
    ('warehouse','pick_confirmations'),('warehouse','pallets'),('warehouse','shipments'),
    ('warehouse','shipping_notice_lines'),('warehouse','stock_adjustments'),
    ('warehouse','slots'),('warehouse','vehicles'),('warehouse','products')
  )
ORDER BY table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position;

sql_calls.sql: SELECT * FROM store.inventory_book WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01' ORDER BY date;
SELECT min(date) AS min_d, max(date) AS max_d, count(*) AS rows FROM store.daily_sales;

SELECT min(audit_ts) AS min_ts, max(audit_ts) AS max_ts, count(*) AS n FROM store.shelf_audits;
SELECT * FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT bill_id) AS n_bills, sum(qty) AS units,
       min(bill_ts) AS first_ts, max(bill_ts) AS last_ts
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01';
SELECT * FROM store.forecasts WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01' ORDER BY date;
SELECT note, count(*) FROM payments.pos_payments GROUP BY note ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT bill_ts::date AS d, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills,
       sum(qty) FILTER (WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS atta_units,
       count(DISTINCT bill_id) FILTER (WHERE sku_scanned<>'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS bills_other
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
